summary: R230 preserves interleaved bootstrap probe/skip ordering per source log so accumulated logs cannot let stale earlier bootstrap evidence masquerade as the latest session outcome. Historical per-kind provenance remains available, while LatestBootstrapOutcomeByLog and conflict diagnostics expose the most recent outcome without changing dormant activation policy.

C1_REVIEW.finding: R229 stores latest completed bootstrap and latest skipped bootstrap in separate maps. If one physical log accumulates multiple process sessions and therefore contains both outcome types, the analyzer cannot state which outcome happened last; stale earlier probe evidence can coexist with a later skip and be over-read as current readiness evidence.
